title: Piano Recital — Mozart, Chopin, Brahms, Debussy & Ravel
description: A classical piano program featuring works by Mozart, Chopin, Brahms, Debussy and Ravel. Playback begins at 5:00.

title: Chanukah Piano Recital
description: A Chanukah recital featuring Shlomo at the piano in works by Mozart, Chopin and Brahms.

title: Mozart, Chopin, Debussy, Liszt & Rachmaninoff
description: A recorded recital featuring Mozart’s Sonata K. 330 (first movement), Chopin’s Nocturne Op. 55 No. 2 and Fantaisie in F minor, Debussy’s Reflets dans l’eau, Liszt’s Funérailles, and Rachmaninoff’s Prelude Op. 32 No. 12.

title: Schumann: Fantasiestücke Op. 12, No. 2, Aufschwung (Soaring)
description: Shlomo Schnall performs Aufschwung (Soaring), the second piece in Robert Schumann’s Fantasiestücke, Op. 12, in a recording shared on his YouTube channel.

title: Chopin: Barcarolle, Op. 60
description: Shlomo performs Chopin’s Barcarolle, Op. 60 at a GEMS concert, shared by Naftali Schindler.

title: Pirates of the Mediterranean
description: Shlomo Schnall performs Pirates of the Mediterranean live, in a recording shared by Mike Schnall.

title: F. Chopin: Valse Brillante
description: A live performance of Chopin’s Valse Brillante by Shlomo Schnall, shared by Mike Schnall.

title: Two Flights Down
description: Shlomo Schnall performs Two Flights Down live, in a recording shared by Mike Schnall.

title: Jewish Jazz — Torat Hashem
description: Shlomo brings a jazz interpretation to the Jewish classic Torat Hashem in this short piano performance.

title: Rachem (Mercy) — Avraham Feintuch & Shlomo Schnall
description: Cantor Avraham Feintuch sings Rachem, in the tradition of Cantor Rosenblatt, with Shlomo Schnall accompanying on piano.
